items.title: 25.3 Dawa ki masnoaat ki synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.3 with Quick Check 25.3 answered (PDF 139-141). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ka sab se ahem istemal dawaiyon (pharmaceutical products) ki synthesis mein hai. Sainkron qeemti dawai compounds ka structure bohat pecheeda lagta hai, lekin agar inhein durust aur samajhdari se disconnect kiya jaye to hum bohat saada aur aam milne wale starting materials tak pohanch jate hain. Yahi organic synthesis ki khoobsurti hai: kuch achhe retrosynthetic steps ke baad intehai pecheeda aur daraune structure bhi saada aur mumkin lagne lagte hain. Aage hum kuch aam dawaiyon ki synthesis dekhenge.
Example 25.3.1 Paracetamol (TM)
Paracetamol ki seedhi (direct) synthesis

blocks.alt: Phenol (benzene ring par HO), phir chaar chhote teer 'A series of steps', aur aakhir mein paracetamol: benzene ring par HO aur saamne wali position par N(H)-C(=O)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 139 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dekha ja sakta hai ke paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis mein kai steps lagte hain. Yeh steps kaun se hain, yeh retrosynthesis se is tarah maloom hota hai:
Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis
Step I Disconnection
Pehla step paracetamol ke amide group ka C–N bond torna hai, jis se synthons milte hain: HO–C₆H₄–NH⁻ (A) aur CH₃CO⁺ (B).
Step II Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride.
Bond isi jagah toora gaya kyun ke in synthons ke synthetic equivalents nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction se aapas mein react karne ke liye jaane pehchane hain.
Step III Functional group interconversion
FGI is liye kiya gaya ke p-nitrophenol (4-nitrophenol) aasani se banta hai aur phir use reduce kar ke p-aminophenol (4-aminophenol) banaya ja sakta hai.
Step IV Disconnection
Phir 4-nitrophenol ka C–N bond toora gaya. Is se 4-hydroxy aryl anion (HO–C₆H₄⁻) aur nitronium (NO₂⁺) cation synthons bane.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step IV mein “disconnection of 4-aminophenol” aur anion ka formula “C₆H₅⁻” chhapa hai. Asal mein jo molecule toota hai woh 4-nitrophenol hai (scheme mein yahi bana hai), aur 4-hydroxy aryl anion ka formula HO–C₆H₄⁻ hai.
Step V Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: phenol aur nitric acid.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step V ke text mein “benzene and nitric acid” likha hai; scheme ke mutabiq 4-hydroxy aryl anion ka synthetic equivalent phenol hai, benzene nahi.

blocks.alt: Paanch qadam. I: paracetamol ke amide C-N bond par katt, Disconnection se HO-C6H4-N(-)H synthon (A) aur +C(=O)CH3 synthon (B). II: synthon (A) = 4-aminophenol (SE); synthon (B) = acyl chloride (SE). III: 4-aminophenol, FGI khula teer, 4-nitrophenol. IV: 4-nitrophenol ke C-NO2 bond par katt se manfi charge wala HO-C6H4 synthon (A) aur NO2+ synthon (B). V: yeh phenol (SE) aur nitric acid HO-NO2 (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis, Steps I-V (kitab ke PDF safha 139-140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step III mein FGI ka teer khula (double) retrosynthetic teer hai, yani “4-aminophenol 4-nitrophenol se ban sakta hai”. Kitab ne yahan aam reaction wala teer chhapa hai, jo ulta matlab deta hai ke aminophenol se nitrophenol banta hai; is liye hamare diagram mein sahi retrosynthetic teer hai.
Paracetamol ki synthesis

Ab paracetamol is scheme ke mutabiq banaya jata hai: phenol ki nitration (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) se 4-nitrophenol, phir Sn + HCl se reduction kar ke 4-aminophenol, aur aakhir mein CH₃COCl ke saath reaction se paracetamol.

blocks.alt: Phenol, 'phenol (SM)', teer ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4 se 4-nitrophenol; Sn + HCl se 4-aminophenol; neeche ki taraf teer CH3COCl se paracetamol, 'Paracetamol (TM)'.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenol ki nitration se 4-nitrophenol ke saath 2-nitrophenol bhi banta hai, jise alag kar liya jata hai. Phir Sn + HCl NO₂ ko NH₂ mein reduce karta hai, aur aakhir mein CH₃COCl amino group ko amide (NHCOCH₃) bana deta hai.
Example 25.3.2 Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid) TM
Aspirin ki seedhi (direct) synthesis

blocks.alt: Phenol, phir chaar chhote teer 'A series of steps', aur aakhir mein aspirin: benzene ring par COOH aur saath wale carbon par O-C(=O)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki seedhi synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 140 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Paracetamol ki tarah aspirin ki seedhi synthesis mein bhi kai steps lagte hain. Retrosynthesis se hum sahi maloom kar sakte hain ke phenol (saada starting material) se aspirin banane ke liye kitne aur kaun se steps darkaar hain.
Aspirin ki retrosynthesis
Retrosynthetic Tree
Step I Disconnection-I
Pehla step aspirin ke ester linkage (ester wale jor) ka C–O bond torna hai, jis se synthons milte hain: 2-carboxyphenoxide ion (A) aur CH₃CO⁺ (B).
Step II Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride.
Step III Disconnection-II
Agla disconnection salicylic acid mein carboxylic group (COOH) aur ring ke darmiyan C–C bond ka hai.
Step IV Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: phenol aur carbon dioxide.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam. I: aspirin (TM) ke ester O-C bond par katt, Disconnection se 2-carboxyphenoxide ion synthon (A) aur +C(=O)CH3 synthon (B). II: synthon (A) = salicylic acid (SE); synthon (B) = acetic anhydride (SE). III: salicylic acid ke ring-COOH bond par katt se OH ke saath wala ring carbanion (A) aur +C(=O)OH (B). IV: yeh phenol (SE) aur carbon dioxide O=C=O (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki retrosynthesis, Steps I-IV (kitab ke PDF safha 141 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aspirin ki synthesis

Ab aspirin is scheme ke mutabiq banti hai: phenol (i) CO₂ ke saath zyada temperature aur pressure par, phir (ii) H₂SO₄ se salicylic acid deta hai; salicylic acid ko acetic anhydride aur H₃PO₄ ke saath garam karne se aspirin banti hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol (SM), teer ke oopar (i) CO2, High T & P aur neeche (ii) H2SO4, se salicylic acid; agle teer ke oopar acetic anhydride aur neeche H3PO4, Heat, se Aspirin (TM).
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki synthesis (kitab ke PDF safha 141 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle step mein CO₂ zyada temperature aur pressure par ring par COOH lagata hai (amal mein phenol ko pehle NaOH se sodium phenoxide banaya jata hai), aur H₂SO₄ se salicylic acid milta hai. Doosre step mein acetic anhydride salicylic acid ke OH ko ester (O–CO–CH₃) bana deta hai; saath ethanoic acid bhi banta hai.
Quick Check 25.3
Aspirin aur paracetamol dono phenol se shuru kar ke banaye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: i) Dono mein functional groups ka kul farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Aspirin mein ring par carboxylic acid group (COOH) aur ester group (O–CO–CH₃) hain; paracetamol mein phenol wala –OH group aur amide group (NH–CO–CH₃) hain.

blocks.prompt: ii) Kis ki synthesis mein FGI (functional group interconversion) shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol ki: 4-nitrophenol ka nitro group amino group mein reduce hota hai (NO₂ → NH₂). Aspirin ki retrosynthesis mein sirf disconnections hain.

blocks.prompt: iii) Dono ki tayyari mein kaun sa synthon mushtarka (common) hai? Is ka structure aur aam synthetic equivalent batayein.
blocks.explanation: Acylium (acetyl) cation, CH₃CO⁺ (CH₃–C⁺=O). Is ka sab se aam synthetic equivalent acyl (ethanoyl) chloride, CH₃COCl, hai; aspirin mein acetic anhydride, (CH₃CO)₂O, istemal hota hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Aspirin: phenol → (CO₂, phir H₂SO₄) salicylic acid → (acetic anhydride, H₃PO₄) aspirin.
Dono mein CH₃CO⁺ synthon istemal hota hai.
